facts.fact: The essay's country table says rural registry offices and civil registration points mostly register births on paper forms, the records being digitised later and transferred electronically to regional and national databases (no date given; the essay's date is used).

The essay's country table cites a National CRVS Strategic Plan 2020-2024 promoting decentralisation to chiefs and councils and digitalisation; the plan's own period ends in 2024.
